| style="color:#2e7d32; font-weight:bold;" |Ice Spike
| style="color:#c62828;" |DMG, Ailment
| style="text-align:left; color:#c62828; padding:10px;" |Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 1x5 grid area in front of the caster, with a 40% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

|[[File:Flame_Jet.png|50x50px]]
|Flame Jet
|DMG
|Deals Fire DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 1×3 grid area in front of the caster.
|
|-
|[[File:Iron_Thorn.png|50x50px]]
|Iron Thorn
|DMG, Ailment
|Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Immobilize for 1 turn.
|
|-
|[[File:Healing_Touch.png|50x50px]]
|Healing Touch
|Ally, Heal, Dispel
|Heals 1 ally within 5 grids of the caster and dispels 1 random ailment or debuff from them.
|
|-
|[[File:Stonechief_Summon.png|50x50px]]
|Stonechief Summon
|Summon
|Summons a Stonechief in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats and remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)
|
|-
|[[File:Fireball.png|50x50px]]
|Fireball
|DMG
|Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square around the target grid.
|
|-
|[[File:Cyclone.png|50x50px]]
|Cyclone
|Drag
|Selects a grid within 6 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, knocking them airborne and pulling them to the target grid.
|
|-
|[[File:Tempest_Sphere.png|50x50px]]
|Tempest Sphere
|DMG
|Deals Wind DMG 5 times to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.
|
|-
|[[File:Void_Blessing.png|50x50px]]
|Void Blessing
|Ally, Buff, Heal
|Increases HP.
|
|-
|[[File:Blazing_Fire_Ring.png|50x50px]]
|Blazing Fire Ring
|DMG
|Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.
|
|-
|[[File:Water_Assault.png|50x50px]]
|Water Assault
|DMG
|Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 3×4 grid area in front of the caster. DMG decreases by 25% for each subsequent hit on the same target. (Deals multiple-hit damage to large targets.)
|
|-
|[[File:Wind's_Delight.png|center|50x50px]]
|Wind's Delight
|DMG
|Selects a grid within 6 grids of the caster. Launches 7 waves of wind blades at the target grid and random enemies within 1 grid to the target grid's left and right. Each wave deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the enemy target. DMG decreases by 35% for each subsequent hit on the same target.
|
|}
